description:
SGP is seeking an experienced Capture Manager to support a dedicated, ongoing engagement with a tribally owned 8(a) and HUBZone small business operating through multiple companies and delivering secure, mission-critical solutions to federal customers. You will lead capture efforts across a diverse portfolio, including secure construction and design-build, facility support and security, cybersecurity and IT modernization, infrastructure and power, healthcare and health IT, and professional and mission support services supporting defense and civilian agencies.

You'll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and be comfortable collaborating closely with client leadership and business development teams while coordinating with SGP's broader consultant network. You'll work alongside the client's existing Capture Manager, coordinating pursuit responsibilities across the portfolio and sharing pipeline management and opportunity qualification activities. You'll also have a demonstrated ability to partner with capture coordinators, proposal managers, writers, editors, graphic designers, and pricing and contracts professionals to ensure capture strategies and win themes are effectively integrated into proposal development.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $120–$140 per hour.

Security Clearance: Active Secret Clearance.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you’ll retain the independence of contract work while accessing a collaborative network of resources to support successful engagements.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who have diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

  • A path to grow: Collaborate with experienced capture managers and gain exposure to capture planning, research, and strategic activities, with opportunities to expand your responsibilities as your experience develops.

Responsibilities

  • Lead capture efforts across a diverse portfolio, including secure construction and design-build (including SCIFs and facilities designed to meet ICD 705 standards), facility operations and maintenance, physical and electronic security, cybersecurity and IT modernization, infrastructure and power, health IT, logistics, and professional and mission support services

  • Pursue opportunities with Department of Defense (DoD) customers, including the Army, Air Force, Navy, NAVFAC, WHS, and combatant commands, as well as civilian agencies such as the Department of State, DHS, GSA, VA, Indian Health Service, and Bureau of Reclamation

  • Develop 8(a) sole-source and set-aside capture strategies, collaborating with program offices, contracting officers, and the Small Business Administration (SBA) to shape requirements and support directed awards, including the sole-source authority available to tribally owned firms

  • Lead opportunity qualification activities and facilitate structured bid/no-bid gate reviews with client leadership

  • Coordinate with the client's existing Capture Manager and business unit leads to align pursuit responsibilities, share qualification analyses, and maintain a consolidated pipeline

  • Recommend appropriate bidding entities for individual pursuits across the client's operating companies and joint ventures, considering eligibility, contract vehicle access, and organizational conflict of interest (OCI) requirements

  • Develop capture plans addressing customer intelligence, competitive positioning, solution strategy, teaming approaches, and price-to-win considerations

  • Identify and structure joint venture, mentor-protégé, and teaming partnerships; support teaming agreements and workshare planning in coordination with client contracts teams

  • Shape opportunities early through customer engagement, RFI and sources sought responses, and industry day participation

  • Develop win themes and discriminators that leverage past performance in secure, highly sensitive environments

  • Maintain pipeline data and capture status in the client's CRM and reporting tools

  • Transition capture strategies to the proposal team and support color team reviews through submission

  • Develop staffing strategies for professional services pursuits, including labor category mapping, key personnel identification, and recruiting and retention approaches

Required Qualifications

  • At least 7 years of experience in federal capture management or business development

  • Demonstrated capture experience in at least two of the following areas: federal construction and design-build (including secure facilities); facility support and physical or electronic security; cybersecurity and IT modernization; infrastructure, telecommunications, and power; healthcare and health IT; or professional services and mission support (including program support and staff augmentation)

  • Hands-on experience with the SBA 8(a) program, including sole-source and set-aside capture strategies

  • Experience pursuing opportunities with Department of Defense (DoD) and federal civilian customers

  • Demonstrated track record of winning competitive and directed federal contracts, with the ability to discuss relevant contract awards

  • Experience with industry proven structured capture processes

  • Strong executive communication and client-facing skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting tribally owned, Alaska Native Corporation, or Native Hawaiian Organization 8(a) firms, including familiarity with sole-source authorities and Buy Indian Act set-asides.

  • Experience with JOC, MATOC, SATOC, and other construction or facilities IDIQ contracts, as well as GSA MAS.

  • Experience structuring joint ventures and mentor-protégé arrangements.

  • Familiarity with HUBZone and other socioeconomic programs.

  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms and opportunity intelligence tools such as GovWin.

  • Experience with price-to-win analysis, including familiarity with construction and services pricing.

  • Active Secret security clearance or higher (confirm requirement).

  • Experience capturing professional services IDIQs and task orders, including labor-category-based bids, key personnel requirements, and staffing plans.
